topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well, there’s a talk in the village 'bout the old Milly’s house going to her grandchildren. It seems the will was clear as the sky after rain, but still, there’s a restlessness in the air. I’ve known Milly’s house since I was a lad, and the thought of it changing hands—it’s like watching a good crop wither. The older boy, he’s been away for years, city ways and such. The girl, she’s always been close to the earth, her hands more calloused than some of the men. It feels...well, it feels like the soil might remember her better. I hope they decide what’s best for all, not just themselves. The land, it has a memory too, and sometimes it whispers what we should do.
